title: A failed history read in the history lightbox shows its heading alone, with no words: no existing sentence is true for it
evidence: 2026-11-14 (PR 1737): HistoryPanel's load now ends the wait on a failed read and shows nothing below Health History (US-21 AC3b). No existing sentence fits: the empty state says there are no measurements, ValuePage's chart line says to check the connection (the read is of the record already held, not a fetch), and US-65's unreadableNote counts unreadable entries. Drafted for Brad: "Your history could not be shown. Reload the page to try again." Scope for the same decision: a failed vitals read also hides the lab charts that did load, though the reads fail independently (widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store.ts:262 loadAllHistory vs :272 loadLabValues), so Brad decides the words and that scope together. On his yes the line goes in HistoryPanel's failed-read branch with its test.
